description: This file defines the class `Opencart\'s` controller for the 'column_left' component, responsible for assembling the modules and layout data for the left-column section of the OpenCart storefront. It handles loading relevant modules based on the current route, layout, and configuration, and returns the rendered HTML view for this section.

classes.name:

classes.description: Controller class for rendering the left column of the storefront, aggregating layout modules based on route and configuration.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the assembly of layout modules for the left column, based on current route, layout ID, and active modules, and returns the view with assembled data.
